title: Family Ties
intro: [excited] Welcome, welcome, welcome to the family reunion! Tonight it's all about Disney moms, dads, brothers and sisters. Grab a seat at the kids' table... [chuckles] and try not to start a sibling rivalry.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A long candlelit family dinner table on a moonlit patio strung with paper lanterns, mismatched chairs of every size from a tall armchair to a tiny high chair, framed family photos and marigold petals scattered across the tablecloth.

categories.title: Rivera Family Reunion
categories.intro: Our film category is Coco! The Riveras are a big, loud, shoe-making family... and boy, do they have opinions about music.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A colourful Mexican family ofrenda glowing with candles, marigold petals, sugar skulls, framed old photographs and a white guitar leaning beside it, a cobblestone plaza at dusk beyond.

clues.clue: Miguel's sweet, elderly great-grandmother gives the movie its title. What's her name?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mamá Coco! [laughs] Getting your name on the movie poster is the ultimate great-grandma flex.

clues.clue: After Mamá Imelda banned music, the Rivera family built its business making these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is shoes! [chuckles] No guitars allowed, but you will get excellent arch support.

clues.clue: This skeleton trickster, who hangs out in the Land of the Dead, turns out to be Miguel's real great-great-grandfather.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Héctor! He wrote Remember Me for his little girl, Coco. Excuse me, I have something in my eye.

clues.clue: At first, Miguel believes his great-great-grandfather is this famous movie-star singer.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ernesto de la Cruz! [sighs] Turns out the guy with the giant guitar statue was a thief. Never trust a man with his own mausoleum.

clues.clue: In the Land of the Dead, Miguel's twin great-great-uncles are Óscar and this brother, who finish each other's sentences.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Felipe! Óscar and Felipe are Mamá Imelda's twin brothers and they still help out in the shoe workshop, even after death. Now that's a family business.

categories.title: Brothers and Sisters
categories.intro: Next up, Brothers and Sisters! Siblings who annoy each other, rescue each other, and steal each other's dessert.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A cosy bedroom with bunk beds, a pillow fort, two mismatched toothbrushes in a cup and a hand-drawn treasure map pinned to the wall, morning sunlight.

clues.clue: Lilo's big sister, who works hard to keep the family together in Hawaii, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Nani! She's a big sister, a mom figure, AND she has to deal with an alien. Give that woman a vacation.

clues.clue: In Peter Pan, Wendy flies off to Neverland with her younger brothers, John and this boy.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Michael! [laughs] The little one with the teddy bear. Bringing a stuffed bear to a pirate fight is a choice.

clues.clue: In Onward, Ian Lightfoot's loud, lovable big brother, who's obsessed with a fantasy role-playing game, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Barley! He drives a van called Guinevere and knows every rule of Quests of Yore. Every family has one.

clues.clue: Merida's mischievous little triplet brothers are Hamish, Hubert and this boy.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Harris! [chuckles] Three tiny redheads, one plate of magic cake, and suddenly there are three bear cubs in the castle.

clues.clue: In Brother Bear, this eldest of the three brothers becomes a spirit eagle after he sacrifices himself.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sitka! Denahi is the middle brother and Kenai is the youngest. Sitka's eagle spirit is the one who turns Kenai into a bear.

categories.title: Family Heirlooms
categories.intro: It's a picture category! Each image shows treasures from a famous film family's home. Name the movie!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A dusty attic full of family treasures: an old trunk, a framed photo, a quilt, a toy rocket and a pressed flower in a book, warm afternoon light through a round window.

clues.clue: These belong to one very super family. Name the movie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Incredibles! Five suits for five Parrs. [whispers] And Edna would want you to notice: no capes.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. Five sleek red-and-black superhero suits on hangers in a mid-century modern closet, sized from a tall muscular adult down to a tiny baby onesie, a pair of black eye masks on a shelf.

clues.clue: This glowing family home has a door for every relative. Name the movie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Encanto! Casita glows thanks to a magic candle, and every Madrigal gets a door. [laughs] Except, you know, one.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A colourful two-storey Colombian hacienda courtyard in the mountains, a row of glowing carved wooden doors on the upper balcony, a single candle burning in a window, yellow butterflies in the air.

clues.clue: A family photo with one face torn away sits on this altar. Name the movie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Coco! That missing face is the whole mystery of the movie. [sighs] Family photos: always more drama than you think.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A candlelit altar covered in orange marigold petals, sugar skulls, pan de muerto bread and an old sepia family photograph with one corner torn off, a white guitar leaning nearby.

clues.clue: A mother and daughter tore this family treasure in two. Name the movie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Brave! Merida slashes the family tapestry, then has to stitch it back before her mum stays a bear forever. [chuckles] Arts and crafts can be dangerous.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A large medieval embroidered family tapestry hanging in a stone Scottish castle hall, torn down the middle between two stitched figures, a sewing needle and thread on a wooden table, a large bear claw mark on the floor.

clues.clue: Two brothers used a wizard's staff to bring back half of their dad. Name the movie.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Onward! Ian and Barley's spell only gets their dad's legs. [laughs] Khakis, socks and dance moves, but no top half.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A pair of men's khaki trousers and loafers standing upright on their own in a suburban living room with nothing above the belt, a carved wooden wizard staff glowing with a blue gem leaning nearby.

categories.title: All in the Family
categories.intro: Parks time! Disneyland was built so families could have fun together, so let's talk family at the parks.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sunny turn-of-the-century theme park main street with a horse-drawn trolley, balloon bunches, a vintage carousel and a fairy-tale castle at the end of the street.

clues.clue: Walt Disney built Disneyland so parents and kids could have fun together. It opened in 1955 in this California city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Anaheim! [excited] Opening day was July 17, 1955. Walt called it a place where parents and children could have fun together.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's giant treehouse is based on this 1960 Disney film about a shipwrecked family.
choices: The Island at the Top of the World
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Swiss Family Robinson! The family builds a dream treehouse with running water. [laughs] Meanwhile, I can't build a bookshelf.

clues.clue: Walt said the idea for Disneyland came while he sat on a bench watching his two daughters, Diane and this girl, ride a merry-go-round.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sharon! Diane and Sharon Disney. That famous bench now sits in Disneyland's Main Street Opera House.

clues.clue: After Walt died, his big brother Roy insisted the Florida resort get this name, so the world would know it was Walt's dream.
clues.reveal: [sighs] The correct answer is Walt Disney World! Roy came out of retirement to finish it and dedicated it in 1971. Big brothers, man.

clues.clue: Main Street, U.S.A. is said to be inspired by this small Missouri town, where Walt lived as a boy.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Marceline, Missouri! Walt lived on the family farm there as a little boy. [chuckles] Fun fact: the town still celebrates him every year.

categories.title: Mom's the Word
categories.intro: Our fan category is all about Disney moms! [chuckles] Name the mother, and call yours after the show.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sunny kitchen windowsill with a vase of fresh flowers, a plate of warm cookies, a knitted blanket and a child-sized handprint drawing taped to the cabinet.

clues.clue: Dumbo's devoted circus mom, who sings him Baby Mine, goes by this name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mrs. Jumbo! [sighs] Baby Mine through the bars of a circus wagon. Pass the tissues, please.

clues.clue: In Finding Nemo, Nemo's mother, seen only in the opening scene, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Coral! She picked the name Nemo. [whispers] And that is the saddest four minutes in Pixar history.

clues.clue: In Tarzan, this gentle gorilla adopts the baby boy as her own.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kala! Kerchak is her mate and Terk is Tarzan's goofy best friend. Kala is the one who says, close your eyes.

clues.clue: Moana's mother, who helps her pack for her voyage, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sina! Gramma Tala is the one with the manta ray tattoo. Sina is the mom who quietly helps Moana leave. [chuckles] Moms know.

clues.clue: In Finding Dory, Dory's mom, who helps lay trails of shells to lead her home, is named this.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Jenny! Charlie is Dory's dad. Together they spent years laying shell trails, just in case she came back.
